goal: Prevents a fee-bumped RBF replacement transaction from getting an older locktime than the original transaction
Closes a privacy leak where such backdating could fingerprint the transaction as coming from Core or Electrum's bumpfee feature
reviewability: Ready for review, final commit received a full ACK and a tACK with only minor nits
Author has consistently addressed feedback and no open concerns remain
agreement: Strong support after extensive iteration across many rounds (molnard, nervana21, polespinasa)
Verified by checking the code and running the tests (molnard)
tACK with only minor non-blocking nits (nervana21)
An architectural alternative was proposed and then withdrawn by its own proposer (molnard)
Approach ACK given earlier in the review (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes a real but narrow privacy leak rather than a broad functional or security issue
Benefit is felt mainly by privacy-conscious users of RBF fee bumping, not the general wallet user base
Author's own data shows it affects under 2% of replaced RBF transactions, so impact is modest
